item.title: FHL - Capital Reconstruction Renewal - High Line Park
item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Procurement | Award | $45.0M | Vendor: Friends of the High Line Inc. In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded a $45 million renewal to Friends of the High Line Inc. for design, construction and construction management of capital reconstruction work on the High Line Park in Manhattan.

The Department of Parks and Recreation ('Parks') intends to enter into a sole source negotiation with the Friends of the High Line, Inc. (FHL) for design, construction and construction management to undertake certain capital reconstruction work for the High Line Park in Manhattan. Parks has determined that FHL is the sole provider for the required services because it has managed the High Line Park since 2000 and is uniquely qualified to undertake this work. Pursuant to a partnership agreement with the City of New York, FHL is responsible for the parks restoration, renovation, maintenance, operations and programing.

item.title: Cyber Security Audit
item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Procurement | Award | $265K | Vendor: Svam International Inc In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Svam International Inc a $265,000 contract, without open competition, for a cyber security audit that will assess the agency's security weaknesses and recommend a plan to improve them.

NYC Parks would like to partner with an outside vendor that specializes in a Cyber Security Assessment process and in building security strategies. This strategy will align with OTIs Cyber Command and industry best practices. This assessment will be able to provide NYC Parks direction on our current security vulnerabilities; build a roadmap for improving our overall security posture and strengthen our alignment for the city; and identify and validate weaknesses in the NYC Parks information security architecture and posture from both an internal and external vantage point.

item.description:
Parks and Recreation | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-11-09 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking sealed bids, due Nov. 9, 2026, from vendors to maintain and repair Automated Logic WebCTRL and Carrier I-Vu building automation systems at Parks facilities citywide.

This Request for Bids is released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this CSB must be submitted via PASSPort.

To access the CSB, vendors should visit the PASSPort public Portal at https://www1.nyc.gov/site/mocs/systems/about-go-to-passport.page and click on the Search Funding Opportunities in PASSPort blue box. Doing so will take one to the public portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the CSB, insert the EPIN, 84627B0012, into the Keyword search field. In order to respond to the CSB, vendors must create an account within the PASSPort system if they have not already done so. The Bid Opening date will be on November 9th, 2026 at 3:00pm.
